title: Debezium: Postgres in, TiDB out, one consumer
tagline: A stock Debezium and Kafka Connect stack replicates into TiDB, and TiDB speaks the same Debezium format back out.
pattern: data platform teams that have already standardized on Debezium and Kafka Connect

metrics.label: Source connector task status
metrics.howMeasured: GET /connectors/postgres-source/status on the Kafka Connect REST API; 1 when every task is RUNNING, else 0.

metrics.label: Source connector records/s
metrics.howMeasured: Rows inserted into Postgres accounts since the previous tick, divided by tick seconds.

metrics.label: Sink connector records/s
metrics.howMeasured: Delta in SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts on TiDB between ticks, divided by tick seconds.

metrics.label: Replication lag (heartbeat)
metrics.howMeasured: Time the heartbeat row is observed in TiDB minus the heartbeat row's source commit time, both read directly, no modeling.

metrics.label: Consumer parse success rate
metrics.howMeasured: Successfully parsed Debezium-shaped messages divided by total messages consumed, across both topics, cumulative for the run.

metrics.label: Schema change propagation time
metrics.howMeasured: Wall-clock time from the add-column control to risk_tier first appearing in INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS on TiDB, polled once per tick.

phases.label: Warming up
phases.narration: This is the Debezium and Kafka Connect stack most data platform teams already run. We're not changing anything about it - we're changing what's on each end.

phases.label: Act A: live replication into TiDB
phases.narration: Postgres is the source of truth today. Every row that lands there is in TiDB within milliseconds, through the same JDBC sink connector you'd point at any relational target.

phases.label: Act B: TiDB as a Debezium source
phases.narration: Now flip it: TiDB is the source. TiCDC speaks Debezium's message format, so the exact same consumer code reads changes from TiDB.

phases.label: Act C: schema change
phases.narration: We add a column live, on the source. Watch how long it takes to show up as a real column in TiDB, and watch the consumer's parse rate while the schema is changing underneath it.

phases.label: Wrap-up
phases.narration: One consumer, two topics, two very different origins - Postgres and TiDB - both spoken in Debezium's own format.

checks.label: Postgres row count equals TiDB row count
checks.description: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts matches on both sides once inserts are idle.

checks.label: Consumer parses both topics without error
checks.description: Cumulative parse-failure count is zero across pg-changes and tidb-changes-dbz.

checks.label: Schema change propagated to the sink
checks.description: risk_tier appears in DESCRIBE accounts on TiDB, with the measured propagation time as observed.

controls.label: Insert burst on Postgres
controls.description: Inserts 200 rows into the Postgres accounts table over a few seconds.

controls.label: Start TiCDC Debezium changefeed
controls.description: Creates the debezium-tidb-source changefeed via the TiCDC OpenAPI v2 if it does not already exist.

controls.label: Add column on Postgres
controls.description: Runs ALTER TABLE accounts ADD COLUMN risk_tier VARCHAR(16) against Postgres.
